mechanism.en: AI slide generators dump whole paragraphs onto one slide (> 120 Latin words or > 280 Chinese chars).
mechanism.zh: AI 生成 PPT 常把整段方案原文直接塞进单页（英文 > 120 词或中文 > 280 字）。

falsePositiveGuards: Hidden slides (`show="0"`) and footers/slide numbers are skipped.

exemplar.bad: Slide 3 packs 215 words of full-sentence prose explaining migration history, rollback scripts, staffing, and Q4 SLA targets.
exemplar.trap: Slide 3 shrinks body font to 9pt so all 215 words fit inside one rounded box.
exemplar.good: Slide 3 headline: 'Zero-downtime migration cut p99 latency from 420 ms to 95 ms' + 3 short metric rows (54 words total); full runbook linked in notes.

mechanism.en: Packing more than 6 bullet points onto one slide flattens hierarchy and makes slides unreadable from a distance.
mechanism.zh: 单页堆超过 6 条项目符号，信息主次彻底散架。

falsePositiveGuards: Hidden slides and title/footer shapes are excluded.

exemplar.bad: Slide lists 9 separate top-level bullets covering pricing, onboarding, compliance, SLA, and billing.
exemplar.trap: Slide wraps 9 bullets into 9 tiny pill badges.
exemplar.good: Slide groups commercial terms into 3 columns: Pricing ($49/seat), Onboarding (2 days), SLA (99.95%).

mechanism.en: OOXML `<a:normAutofit fontScale="...">` below 80000 is deterministic proof that copy overflowed its layout box.
mechanism.zh: OOXML 中 `normAutofit fontScale < 80000` 是文案撑破文本框、被强行缩小的确定性证据。

falsePositiveGuards: Hidden slides are skipped; only triggers below 80% scale.

exemplar.trap: Manually hardcode 10pt font so `normAutofit` disappears while text stays illegible.
exemplar.good: <a:noAutofit/> with 42 words set at 18pt and full line spacing

mechanism.en: Dense content slides titled `Overview` / `Background` / `项目背景` / `概述` waste the top visual slot instead of stating the takeaway.
mechanism.zh: 正文密集页却只用“项目背景/概述/Overview”当标题，没有亮出本页结论。

falsePositiveGuards: Section dividers with <= 25 Latin words and <= 50 CJK chars are exempt.

exemplar.bad: Title: 'Background' (above 65 words detailing 38% cart abandonment on mobile Safari)
exemplar.good: Title: 'Mobile Safari accounts for 38% of cart abandonment due to 4-step address entry'

mechanism.en: Generated decks repeat the identical title + single plain-bullet box across 4+ consecutive content slides without any table, chart, or visual diagram.
mechanism.zh: 在 5 页以上内容演示文稿中，连续 4 页及以上全部退化为“标题 + 单纯字要点框”（无图表、无表格、无配图），视觉极度单调。

falsePositiveGuards: Skips hidden slides and short cover/section divider slides (< 12 words and < 25 CJK chars).
Resets run whenever a slide includes a chart (`<c:chart>`), table (`<a:tbl>`), image (`<p:pic>`), or multi-column structure.

exemplar.bad: Slides 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 each contain only a top title and a single bullet list with zero tables, charts, or diagrams.
exemplar.trap: Slides 2–6 keep the same bullet lists but add purple gradient backgrounds.
exemplar.good: Slide 3 turns the comparison bullets into a 3-column table and Slide 5 uses a latency chart.

name.en: Default Purple-Pink AI Gradient & Clipped Gradient Text
name.zh: 默认紫粉渐变与渐变大字

mechanism.en: Default LLM Tailwind/CSS output falls back to indigo/purple/pink neon gradients and `bg-clip-text text-transparent` headlines.
mechanism.zh: 默认前端生成习惯使用蓝紫/紫粉高饱和渐变和 `bg-clip-text` 渐变标题。

falsePositiveGuards: Comments, scripts, and code blocks are masked; solid neutral palettes stay clean.

exemplar.bad: Release Notes v2.4
exemplar.trap: Release Notes v2.4

mechanism.en: Wrapping > 6 short metadata tokens per view in `rounded-full` / `999px` badges creates visual noise.
mechanism.zh: 单视图堆叠超过 6 个 `rounded-full` / `999px` 文字胶囊，淹没真正的状态提示。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts circular avatars/dots (`size-*` or equal `w-N h-N`) and <= 6 pills.

exemplar.trap: 8 square pastel badges with 8 emoji icons on one card.
exemplar.good: Plain mono metadata line: `v2.4 · us-west-2 · SOC2` + single status word `degraded` when unhealthy.

mechanism.en: Generated dashboards stack 3+ nested bordered/shadowed rounded containers around the same data, eating up padding and visual clarity.
mechanism.zh: AI 面板常把同一项内容包进 3 层及以上带边框/阴影/圆角的容器里，层层套盒。

falsePositiveGuards: Single-side dividers (`border-t`, `border-b`) and 1–2 level cards are exempt.

exemplar.bad: 99.98% uptime
exemplar.trap: 99.98% uptime

mechanism.en: Generated UI copies hype labels (`AI-Powered`, `Zero Hallucination`, `AI 强力驱动`) straight into eyebrow tags instead of describing the real feature.
mechanism.zh: 界面眉题或徽章直接印出“AI-Powered”“AI 强力驱动”“零幻觉保证”等空洞宣传语。

falsePositiveGuards: Scoped to `ui-text` zone so comments and scripts stay masked.

exemplar.trap:
Built for Craft · Pure Signal

Document Checker
exemplar.good: Document Linter for Markdown, HTML, DOCX & PPTX

name.zh: 毛玻璃半透明面板滥用

mechanism.en: Repeating `backdrop-blur` / `backdrop-filter: blur(...)` on 3+ panels per view mimics default AI glassmorphism dashboards and degrades legibility.
mechanism.zh: 单视图堆砌 3 处及以上 `backdrop-blur` / `backdrop-filter: blur(` 毛玻璃面板，呈现典型生成式模板腔。

falsePositiveGuards: Allows 1–2 legitimate uses (e.g., sticky top nav + modal overlay).

exemplar.bad:
Nav
A
B

mechanism.en: Stacking 3+ `border-l-4` / `border-left: 4px solid` KPI cards replicates boilerplate AI admin dashboards.
mechanism.zh: 单视图堆叠 3 处及以上左侧粗彩条卡片（`border-l-4` / `border-left: >=3px solid`），呈现典型 AI 后台面板套路。

falsePositiveGuards: Exempts `blockquote` selectors/tags and <= 2 occurrences per file.

exemplar.bad:
KPI 1
KPI 2
KPI 3
exemplar.trap: KPI 1

name.en: Process-Label Slide Headline Instead of Finding
name.zh: 过程标签式标题（缺结论句）

mechanism.en: Executive slide headings say 'Analysis of Q3 Churn' or '关于……的分析汇报' instead of stating the conclusion and delta.
mechanism.zh: 管理层汇报标题只写“关于……的分析汇报”，把听众最关心的结论埋进小字里。

falsePositiveGuards: Matches explicit process-label heading prefixes ('Analysis of...', '关于...的分析汇报'); assertion headings pass cleanly.

exemplar.bad: ## 关于三季度新客首周流失率的分析汇报
exemplar.trap: ## 重塑新客留存增长飞轮
exemplar.good: ## 三季度简化实名认证步骤后，新客首周流失率从 34% 降至 19%
